deliveryDirection: Energetic, curious, conversational product storyteller. Warm confidence. Smile on the reversal. Land verbs; do not shout or read like a news anchor. Natural pauses, varied sentence melody.

segments.text: Good tools fit us. A pen gets a grip. A hammer gets a handle. A chair gets a backrest, armrests, wheels. We keep shaping tools around the people who use them.

segments.text: So why does software so often work the other way around? Pick an app. Learn its menus. Bend your workflow to fit. And when your needs change... start again.
